mapping.summary: Imports bank transactions via open banking into BC reconciliation journals.
claims: Connects to over 2,000 banks in 31 European countries and the UK
Transactions land in payment reconciliation journal or bank account reconciliation
No statement file downloads or bank portal logins
Read-only PSD2 access through a regulated account information provider
Scheduled import via job queue or on demand
Manual import of past periods within the bank's history
Discards duplicate transactions by bank transaction ID
Reason codes from bank texts propose the account per line
Fixed G/L accounts for bank fees, interest and taxes
Default reason codes for ISO 20022, CBI and ZKA
Email warning before a bank connection expires, with renewal link
Role center cues for expiring connections and bank errors
One licence per tenant covers all companies
40 EUR per month for up to 3 bank accounts, 10 EUR per extra account
